content.comment_body: Hello. Can anyone advise where to obtain the .gsd file for [article_no]?

Hello, [product_name] is not a Profibus DP slave. Communication is possible using ethernet. How do you set up an S7 connection (server/client) between a [product_name] [article_no] and an [product_name] CPU? Best regards, [user_name]

There isn't a GSD file for [product_name]. [product_name] doesn't support profibus. Only Ethernet TCP/IP or modbus TCP/IP is available. Modbus is supported if the [product_name] is: - from series 8.1 with FS04 or newer. - from series 8.2.
Despite this, it is connected via MPI and is operational. The original project differs—I intended to upload the station to PG.
Apologies, my previous comment was incorrect—it's actually not a [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user seeks a GSD file for [product_name] [article_no] to enable Profibus or MPI communication but learns from others that this product does not act as a Profibus DP slave and does not support MPI, offering only Ethernet/TCP-IP or, in certain versions, Modbus TCP/IP. The discussion highlights user confusion around supported communication protocols and reflects unclear documentation regarding protocol compatibility for specific [product_name] models.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipated that [product_name] [article_no] would support Profibus and MPI and be configurable via a GSD file, similar to other [company_name] products.
